data.title: REG - capAI PLC - Clarification Re: Admission of Ordinary Shares
data.description:
RNS Number : 8362P capAI PLC 07 August 2026  

7 August 2026

capAI plc

(the "Company" and, together with its subsidiaries and subsidiary undertakings, the "Group" or "capAI")

Clarification Regarding Admission of Ordinary Shares

capAI plc (LSE: CPAI, OTCQB: CPIQF) (the "Company") refers to its announcements dated 7 May 2026 regarding the exercise of warrants and 5 August 2026 regarding the Company's £280,000 fundraise (the "Fundraise").

Following a review of the Company's admission arrangements, it was noted that the admission to trading of the 5,290,000 Ordinary Shares issued pursuant to the exercise of warrants announced on 7 May 2026 (the "Warrant Shares") had not been completed at that time.

The Company has therefore included the Warrant Shares within its current application for admission to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange alongside the shares issued pursuant to the Fundraise.

Accordingly, a total of 70,178,887 Ordinary Shares of £0.0001 each (the "Admission Shares") will be admitted to trading, with admission expected to become effective and dealings expected to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 10 August 2026, comprising:

·      62,222,221 new Ordinary Shares issued pursuant to the Fundraise;

·      2,666,666 new Ordinary Shares* issued to advisers in connection with the Fundraise; and

·      5,290,000 Ordinary Shares previously issued following the exercise of warrants.

For the avoidance of doubt, the Warrant Shares were issued on 7 May 2026 and do not represent a further issue of shares or any additional fundraising proceeds.

Following admission of the Admission Shares, the Company's issued share capital will comprise 491,321,950 Ordinary Shares. The Company does not hold any shares in treasury and, accordingly, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 491,321,950.

All other details contained in the Company's announcement dated 5 August 2026 remain unchanged.

SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC Q2 2026: Revenue $325.7M, EPS $2.36— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $325.7M and net income of $34.52M, driven by higher premiums and favorable underwriting trends offset in part by elevated weather-related claims; diluted EPS was $2.36 for the quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $325.7M for Q2 2026, compared with $316.3M in Q2 2025; YoY change 3.0%.
  • Net income was $34.52M for Q2 2026, compared with $28.94M in Q2 2025; YoY change 19.3%.
  • Diluted EPS was $2.36 for Q2 2026, compared with $1.95 in Q2 2025; YoY change 21.0%.

Business Highlights

  • Net earned premiums grew about 5.0% year-to-date to $582.6M, supported by rate increases despite modest declines in policy counts.
  • The company continues to rely on its independent agent network (797 agents across 1,063 locations) and is pruning underperforming agencies.
  • Severe winter storms generated roughly 1,800 claims totaling about $42.7M, pushing the six-month loss ratio to 76.0% and increasing reserves.
  • Underwriting momentum included improved private passenger accident frequency and approved rate filings across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine, which raised average premium per policy.
  • SAFETY Insurance entered a merger agreement to be acquired for $105.00 per share, which is expected to trigger transaction costs and potential integration activity.

Original SEC Filing: SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC [ SAFT ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026
